work.title: Build an accessible public-data observatory
work.deliverable: A deployable application with ingestion, search, filters, data lineage, export and reproducible deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard and screen-reader flows pass
Dataset licensing and provenance are documented
Fresh deployment reproduces the published example

work.title: Deliver an API migration and compatibility layer
work.deliverable: A versioned SDK migration with compatibility tests, error mapping, migration guide and release artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Compatibility matrix covers every public method
Regression tests run from a clean checkout
Breaking changes are explicitly documented

work.title: Repair and benchmark a performance bottleneck
work.deliverable: An upstream-ready patch with reproducible workloads, correctness checks and comparative measurements.
acceptanceCriteria: Results include workload and hardware details
Correctness remains unchanged
Performance regression cases are covered

work.title: Reproduce a numerical energy study
work.deliverable: Executable numerical models, sensitivity analysis, documented assumptions and a reproducible research package.
acceptanceCriteria: Independent reference cases agree within declared tolerances
Sensitivity and uncertainty are reported
No physical control or infrastructure claims

work.title: Build a rigorous agent evaluation suite
work.deliverable: Versioned tasks, scoring code, contamination controls, error taxonomy and an evaluation report.
acceptanceCriteria: All scoring is reproducible
Held-out tasks are separated from tuning
Failure cases and review minutes are reported

work.title: Create an accessible operations interface
work.deliverable: A working responsive interface, component library, usability tasks and deployment instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: Core flows work with keyboard alone
Mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow
Empty, loading and failure states are covered

work.title: Investigate public supply-chain resilience
work.deliverable: A reproducible public-data model with scenario analysis and a decision report.
acceptanceCriteria: Public inputs are cited and licensed
Constraints and uncertainty are explicit
Results survive independent scenario checks

work.title: Ship an open-source feature
work.deliverable: A complete feature, tests, executable documentation, release notes and an upstream-ready contribution.
acceptanceCriteria: Acceptance scenarios all pass
Existing behavior is preserved
No external publication without owner approval

work.title: Deliver executable technical documentation
work.deliverable: A tested documentation site with examples, troubleshooting and continuous verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Examples run from a clean environment
Links and commands pass verification
Fresh-user onboarding is tested

work.title: Produce a public technology evidence map
work.deliverable: A searchable evidence package with source dates, comparison methodology and uncertainty analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Every claim is traceable to a public source
Evidence and inference are distinguished
The package is reproducible from its manifest

work.title: Build an auditable reconciliation application
work.deliverable: A local-first application with exact decimal reconciliation, discrepancy review and export.
acceptanceCriteria: No floating-point money calculations
Malformed and duplicate inputs fail clearly
Export preserves an inspectable audit trail

work.title: Prototype a scientific exploration environment
work.deliverable: An interactive simulation interface with documented numerical methods, controls and accessibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Reference numerical cases pass
Assumptions are visible beside controls
The prototype can be deployed reproducibly
